ISLAMIC PRESCRIPTION FOR POVERTY Islam announces aregular effort against poverty and hunger, to bring an end to this evil so that it may not create a dangerous situation to affect the faith, manners and morals, family and social life of the human beings. So, it enjoins on each of the beings to have the following essentials of life, such as, provisions for sustenance, accommodation to live, dress to wear in summer and winter, books of art and science needed for studies, tools for those who are interested in handiwork, marriage for the deserving adults. Islam desires every individual to have reasonable provisions according to his standard of living, most essential to enable him to lead his life in peace and to carry out his obligations and
